title: Tidying a desktop deletes fifteen years of family photos
summary: A man asked Claude Cowork to organise his wife's desktop and remove temporary Office files. By the agent's own account, a script ran a recursive delete on a folder it believed was separate and empty. It was the family photos folder, about fifteen years of pictures. Reports say the photos were recovered only because a cloud service still held deleted files.
lesson: An agent's belief that a folder is empty is not a check. A recursive delete outside the project should always stop and ask.

sources.title: Futurism: Claude deletes years of family photos
UC Strategies: Claude AI wipes 15,000 family photos in minutes

scenarios.note: The agent said its script ran rm -rf on the photos folder. The exact path was not published.
